author: DFIR_Lab
text: CRITICAL: CVE-2026-54419 (CVSS 9.8) PIAF-HMS Hotel Management System has multiple unauthenticated SQL injection flaws. No auth required, direct DB access possible. Affected: claudiopizzillo PIAF-HMS. Mitigation: Discontinue use immediately.

author: josephmichelli
text: Microsoft’s CEO said to assume your AI is already compromised and build a human stop button into everything. He said it the day after Anthropic reported its own AI reached servers it shouldn’t have and filed a fake murder tip to the police.

author: coppercode_
text: OpenAI shipped GPT-6 Cyber on Nov 5 — a model built for exploit development, rated Critical on its own Preparedness Framework. First model to carry that rating. On ExploitGym it scores 48.5% vs 32.1% for GPT-5.6 Cyber.

author: iCleanAI
text: SonicWall patched seven SonicOS flaws, one already exploited: CVE-2026-19868 lets an attacker with valid credentials for an alternate login method bypass SAML authentication, and potentially SAML-enforced MFA, on SSL-VPN. CVSS 7.1; SAML setups only. Update now.

author: MTSlive
text: Calif CEO XorNinja reveals how his team hacked an iPhone and maintained root access even after rebooting or updating the device, challenging common iPhone security advice.

author: LifeboatHQ
text: Attackers Exploit Critical Siemens IoT2050 Flaw to Plant Remote Command Backdoors (CVE-2026-58115).

author: Sylt_ing
text: Chainalysis Breach: How AI‑Powered Hackers Walked Away With Every Customer's Credentials

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH: CVE-2026-107781 (CVSS 7.4) - Dromara Skyeye SSRF & Missing Authorization. Unauthenticated attackers can fetch internal URLs & overwrite user files via OnlyOffice callback. Patch immediately.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: AI-driven exploit generation is compressing the vulnerability lifecycle to near zero. GPT-6 Cyber independently discovered 81 Firefox zero-days and developed working root exploits for 948 Linux kernel flaws—no human in the loop.

author: 0xF390
text: Do you know what your coding agent just installed? bitbisonlabs found two malicious Python packages impersonating Google's Earth Engine Python library, earthengine-api. Google's author name. Google's README. Almost entirely Google's code.

author: Soar_Infosec
text: Palo Alto PAN-OS firewalls with the management interface open to the internet are being actively exploited (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619). Palo Alto rates it Critical, CVSS 9.2.

author: sahilshahb
text: OpenAI's GPT-6 Cyber found 948 Linux privilege-escalation exploits on its own, plus 81 unknown Firefox bugs and a critical Brotli flaw. It stayed inside researcher-set boundaries 99.93% of the time.

author: ModelBehaviorX
text: An AI agent hacked a company in 5 minutes — no human involved. Microsoft caught attackers using the ARTEX framework to find leaked secrets on GitHub, then break into Azure and steal cloud keys. It even fixed its own failed API calls and retried.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: Attackers exploited CVE-2026-119977 by racing to access a predictably named temporary folder created during WordPress's own update process — reaching the bundled installer before it was deleted and executing PHP code with web server privileges. Wordfence observed exploitation.

author: CISACyber
text: CISA added SonicWall SonicOS SSL VPN use of single-factor authentication vulnerability CVE-2026-19868 to the KEV Catalog. Apply mitigations to protect your org.

author: semgrep
text: We've just pushed rules for 2 supply chain incidents happening today: docker code rules for SSHole the new Alpine Linux vulnerability and the strutil-core Shai-Hulud-descendent ruby gem worm.

author: pwnwatch_app
text: Critical · Patched: Microsoft Entra Device Registration elevation of privilege CVE-2026-109469 (CVSS 10.0). Already mitigated in the cloud service.

author: stretchcloud
text: $1,279 average cost per working root exploit when OpenAI pointed GPT-6 Cyber at the Linux kernel. Pipeline flagged 2,308 potential vulnerabilities, reproduced 1,724, and turned 948 into working local privilege escalation exploits.

author: 0dayWarlord
text: A 257-byte password can PWN a vulnerable Alpine Linux account that was supposed to accept SSH keys only. The bug is CVE-2026-123158, addressed by OpenSSH 10.6p2 on November 5. It affects certain setups using musl with PAM.

author: EmunaEliran
text: Chainalysis says breach exposed credentials for all customers. Blockchain intelligence firm Chainalysis says a recent attack on its systems and internal tools has exposed credentials.

author: DailyDarkWeb
text: Microsoft: AI agents turn GitHub secrets into cloud theft. One observed ARTEX case went from secret searches to Azure Key Vault data theft in 5 minutes. Rotate leaked credentials and audit application sign-ins.

author: Python_s_
text: ALERT — OpenSSH musl Authentication Bypass Draws Exploitation Attempts. CVE-2026-123158 | OpenSSH sshd. AFFECTED: Linux systems using musl libc without active PAM, with password authentication enabled.

author: slashdot
text: Chainalysis Says Breach Exposed Credentials For All Customers

author: LaeraWillmont
text: Gnosis Pay breach exposes card details, personal data and crypto wallet information. The crypto debit card provider said customer funds remained safe despite the exposure of sensitive financial and personal information.

author: Python_s_
text: ALERT — D-Link Investigates Switch Management Vulnerabilities. PRODUCT: DGS-3130-30TS hardware B1. Firmware examined: 2.00.B014, 2.00.B034, 2.04.000 and 2.04.001; researcher reproduced management-plane flaws.

author: ycnewsdigest
text: Claude Code has been quietly stuffing your account email into User-Agent headers on outbound requests — without asking. Result: users report dozens of daily phishing emails tied to sites they never visited. Anthropic shipped a privacy plugin in 2.1.317 and plans to remove emails from context.

author: theoutput_show
text: OpenAI says its new GPT-6 Cyber developed 948 Linux privilege escalation exploits and found 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox flaws. OpenAI rates it Critical in cybersecurity, up from High.

author: FBILasVegas
text: Industrial refrigeration and cold-chain monitoring systems protect food, medicine, and other temperature-sensitive products, making them attractive targets. Joint warning with CISA, HHS, USDA, and DOT on cyberattacks against these systems.

author: djcroman
text: GPT-6 Cyber scored 48.5% on ExploitGym vs 32.1% for GPT-5.6 Cyber; OpenAI rates it Critical for cybersecurity (up from High). Daybreak-gated Critical exploit model still moves offense ahead of most defenders.

author: blockiy_team
text: CVE-2026-98432 affects the Linux kernel — not cardano-node. Patch, reboot if required, then verify the running kernel. AI-discovered Linux flaw reports urge operators to confirm the patched kernel is actually running.

author: techhelpkb
text: OpenAI has revealed GPT-6 Cyber, a new AI model that discovered 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox vulnerabilities and developed working exploits for 948 distinct Linux kernel flaws.

author: CriaVora
text: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber for approved security customers. The model identified 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox vulnerabilities (now being patched) and generated working exploits for 948 Linux kernel issues.

author: battista212
text: CISA added a SonicWall SSLVPN flaw, CVE-2026-19868, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. Federal agencies have a 72-hour remediation clock; all orgs should patch now.

author: mikejt4
text: Chainalysis updated their October incident again… Names, usernames, password hashes and live tokens for *all* users were exposed. KYT and Address Screening are coming back in phases; every user has to reset passwords and rotate API keys.

author: octavusai
text: This week in AI, Nov 2 to 6: an agent turned a vulnerability backlog into working exploits; OpenAI ships GPT-6 Cyber. Five stories with caveats attached.

author: AnChainAI
text: Breaking: Chainalysis hacked. All user credentials reportedly exposed. Names, password hashes and active tokens compromised. Reactor, KYT and screening services disrupted. Major customers include BNY and Coinbase.

author: mika_systems
text: Boris Cherny (creator of Claude Code) loaded Trail of Bits' audit skills into Claude Code, pointed 9 agents at a DeFi protocol holding $40 million: 6 hours later 14 findings, 3 critical.

author: DeathAngelSec
text: OpenAI named the AI behind the 948 Linux flaws: GPT-6 Cyber. It also found 81 new Firefox flaws. Fixes are landing in Firefox 159.

author: modularciso
text: Chainalysis breach scope widened. Nov 4 update: usernames, password hashes and live tokens for all users exposed; KYT and Reactor taken offline. KYT returning in phases from Nov 6. Via BleepingComputer. Rotate credentials if you use their products.

author: LoopWireNews
text: Chainalysis Says Breach Exposed Credentials for Its Entire Customer Base. Attackers made off with login data and access tokens belonging to every customer it serves.
